verdict.rationale: npm documents a registry API, including a package-metadata ('packument') endpoint and search qualifiers. The CLI also covers core actions such as search, publish, and account creation/login, so much of the core workflow can be done without the web UI. Nothing shows that the API or CLI matches everything the npmjs.com UI can do, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity (e.g., org/team management, account settings, tokens, 2FA via API), a published OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This endpoint responds with the package metadata document, sometimes informally called a "packument" or "doc.json".
`scope:foo`: Show/filter results published under the `@foo` scope
Use the [`npm publish`](/cli/v11/commands/npm-publish) command to upload your code to the registry.
adduser: Create an account or log in.
Use the `npm search` command to show everything that's available in the public registry.
